plan.comparability: Same fold and evaluation samples as the static screen. Different sequence optimizer batching and learning rate; this is not a compute-matched architecture comparison.
plan.comparison: Only aggregate phase weighting changes from the paired absolute-loss report. Fit-fold rows alone determine normalization; each available phase receives one third of fitting loss mass. Within-phase row ratios are retained. No independent game coverage is manufactured.
plan.decision_rule: A candidate is plausible only if both seeds improve pooled out-of-fold MAE by at least 0.005 and each phase has no more than 0.01 regression. Any failing fold is reported. This screen cannot establish final acceptance, recurrence sufficiency or late coverage. If no variant qualifies, do not select the least-bad variant.
plan.epoch_selection: Fixed final epoch; no tuning to held-out training-fold labels.
plan.evaluation: All out-of-fold phase representative predictions retained. Report pooled and per-fold/phase/seat/style gains, training fit and correction magnitude. Do not choose a model from an aggregate concealing late regressions.
plan.loss: Absolute error with unchanged episode/reached-phase weights
plan.purpose: Training-only causal-memory diagnostic, without the previously confounding power-6 gate. No model promotion. Complete ordered games and exact zero memory resets.
plan.repetition: Unchanged hyperparameters, seeds and family folds on the new bridge-pressure/reactive-defense training shard. No selection/calibration/holdout labels used.
